notes: VCA306 (v3): both paint-timing fixes (paintWhenInitiallyHidden, off-screen-shown window) still printed blank on dad's GPU. Root evidence: on that hardware silent HTML print() AND capturePage come out blank, but printToPDF renders the same slip correctly (it powers the WhatsApp slip image). So printReceipt now renders the slip to a PDF and prints the PDF — Chromium's PDFium print path doesn't depend on the HTML compositor that's failing on his GPU. The PDF encodes the exact 80mm width + content height, which also fixes the short mis-cut. Direct HTML print kept as fallback. Needs on-hardware verification.
